Visit note | 2025-07-19 12:00 PM | Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, Cardiology | Patient: Shapla Munshi, 65, female. Mrs. Munshi attends for a follow-up visit regarding her ongoing condition and mentions she has been experiencing morning headaches and occasional dizziness, though she has no other complaints. She is a homemaker, lives in Rampura, and her condition was first found during a free health camp in Rampura. She has no known comorbidities. On examination, her blood pressure reading is BP 146/106 mmHg, with a pulse of 74 bpm and a weight of 67 kg. Heart sounds are normal. Assessment: Essential hypertension. Plan: chronic follow-up; continue current medicines, no new prescription issued. She was advised to cut down on salt, pickles, and dried fish, walk 30 minutes daily, and check blood pressure at home twice a week. Follow-up in 1 month with home blood pressure readings.
